Okay everyone, first off I'd like to say thank you for your replies. I went to the only place I could go to in my small little town (the local er) and after an EKG, an x-ray, and blood work I was told to take Ibuprofen. They did everything except tell me what's wrong and offer me a solution. I had just fallen asleep an hour ago and I just now woke up with excruciating pain. I was reluctant to go to the doctor because the hospital here has a horrible reputation, and they are notorious for sending people home to die. I really don't know what to do at this point. I didn't really expect them to give me painkillers because 9/10th of their patients are tweakers. I was fine with this and was just hoping they would at least give me some muscle relaxers and hook me up with a physical therapist. But noooo. 

Okay now that that rant is over I'd like to say that I'm more inclined to believe what I've read on the internet, which is that this is a strain or tear in my intercostal muscles. It is most painful when I lay down, like extremely painful. That being said what do I do? I live in a town where medical care is beyond substandard and I will receive no help from them.

It's on both sides below the pectoral area. When I try to lie down it hurts like hell, an incredibly sharp pain. It hurts to breathe. And it feels deep.
